videos.title: Inside the Unprecedented SEC Bailout of Stocks & Crypto | Major Rule Change
videos.point: SEC innovation exemption lets 1:1 tokenized stocks trade on-chain for 5 years without exchange registration or best-execution — framed as a bailout after Clarity Act failed.
content: On-chain stock tokens, no exchange registration, no best bid/offer
Timing: ~2 days after Clarity Act failed
Benefits crypto rails and brokers (Robinhood called out)
videos.watch_why: Skip the first ~5 minutes; the rule is the payload.

videos.title: Iran Laughs "TRUMP WON'T DO IT"... Then Their Power Plants GET VAPORIZED
videos.point: Commentary packaging Trump threats to knock out Iranian power plants/bridges; title oversells that plants were already vaporized.
content: Trump: could take out power plants in a day / bridges in an hour
Framed as leverage in stalled talks
News-clip montage + opinion, not battle damage

videos.title: LIVE: Heavy Clashes In Iran - Anti-IRGC Armed Iranians Target More Cities
videos.point: Long live stream claiming armed anti-IRGC clashes spreading to more Iranian cities; opposition-channel reporting, not verified wire copy.
content: Theme: internal armed resistance vs IRGC

videos.title: Trump Issues NEW WARNING | Iran Tankers Struck AGAIN
videos.point: Trump talking annihilate / restart major strikes while tanker-for-tanker hits continue in Hormuz.
content: Axios: decision point on restarting massive attacks

videos.title: What Happens to Your Body After Stopping Ozempic
videos.point: Stopping Ozempic: side effects can linger; 25–40% of loss can be muscle; regain is mostly fat unless you change training and food.
content: Berg: protein, lifting, don’t treat the drug as the plan

videos.title: IRGC Mobilizes 313,000 Troops As Trump Weighs MASSIVE Iran Strikes
videos.point: Tehran staged a ~313k Janfada/Fedayeen parade while Trump publicly weighs restarting big strikes.
content: Trump: big decision on resuming major attacks

videos.title: Victor Davis Hanson: "An Earth-Shattering Event Is Going To Happen In Iran..."
videos.point: VDH clip: after ~6 months of pressure he puts ~30% odds the Iranian street snaps.
videos.watch_why: Hanson bit is short; rest is wrapper.
